summary.headline: Astrology of Illness and Treatment
summary.text: Astrological diagnosis and prognosis of illness through Mars, the Moon, Saturn, and the Sun, including critical seventh- and fourteenth-day configurations and signs of recovery or death. F. 18 gives a further medical delineation assigning the ascendant to the doctor, midheaven to the sick person, setting to the disease, and subterranean angle to treatment.
